title: Post the build: three posts from real work
purpose: Three posts from the build: a decision, a diagram, the system in motion.
why: Screenshots alone don't land. What problem the screen represents, the decision you made, and why it matters is what makes people stop.
evidence: Link to your best post of the three.

modules.title: Write posts that sound like you

tasks.title: Screenshot + the decision behind it
tasks.done_when: Says what problem, what you decided, why it matters.

tasks.title: Architecture or workflow diagram post
tasks.done_when: Someone who never saw the code understands the system.

tasks.title: A gif or short video of the system working
tasks.done_when: Shows the feature doing its job, start to finish.
